existing_vm: Existing protected AppRole files, private identity manifest, managed RAM links and approved connector start marker persist independently of Terraform. Public install helper fails closed if absent.
fresh_vm_blockers: First source apply can stage clone/packages but fails closed until an authorized out-of-band bootstrap supplies root-only AppRole files and the original private identity manifest via SSH stdin. A subsequent reviewed apply is required.
New empty MariaDB datadir/account initialization is intentionally NOT automated. Native DB/user bootstrap needs separate explicit coordination; source never alters existing passwords/grants.
Cloudflared binary and approved same-static-connector start marker must exist. No latest-binary download or provider credential fallback.
ci_owner_interface: Vault plugin reads a separately scoped bootstrap payload; serialize JSON from masked CI env to bootstrap-from-stdin.py over SSH stdin, not CLI args/tfvars/file provisioners. No bootstrap KV path or auth values are assumed/provisioned by this source. CI agent owns pipeline wiring and paused-job release gate.
migration: Fresh read-only native DB backup; stop API Agent; run same migrate_all.py under a one-shot official Agent with the existing API AppRole and RSA adapter; always restart API in finally. One Agent at a time; no app credentials in Terraform transport/state.
state_history: Existing Terraform states/backups retain historical payloads until separately approved lifecycle handling. No automatic state deletion, imports, password rotation or history wipe.
